firstPlayerRule: Each player states the largest number of tiles they can play in one color or one shape without duplicates. The player with the largest such group plays those tiles first.
officialTieBreak: If players have equally large opening groups, the oldest of those players goes first.
interpretation: The same tiles cannot repeat a color and shape within the claimed opening group.
